remarks: This very spacious condo in popular Leefair has been beautifully renovated. The main level Living Room with bookcases and fireplace is open to the Dining Room that accesses the private patio with lighting, gardens and an awning. There are two Bedrooms, including the lovely Primary with an incredible updated skylit bathroom, a walk-in closet and the second Bedroom has access to another redone hall bath. The Office completes the main living area.  Downstairs, there is a large Family Room with an entertainment area with fridge drawers and room for your favorite wine bottles. Laundry is downstairs, as well as a full bath and two storage areas with shelving.There is also another office. Leefair is close to town, the highly regarded Library and Metro North. It also holds the distinction of being one of the most popular condo complexes in lovely New Canaan.
